# Assure

Assure is verified document compilation: it extracts facts with their source pages, checks them against your rules with the Z3 SMT solver, stress-tests the draft adversarially, and lets a person decide before export.

## Four stages

- ParSure: Reads every file, including scans and handwritten reports, and anchors each extracted figure to its exact page, cell or row.
- CrossSure: Compiles domain rules and extracted facts into formal constraints and checks them with Z3, an SMT solver; every contradiction names the two sources in conflict.
- Red-Hat: Runs an adversarial stress-test on the draft for unsupported claims, omitted clauses and policy gaps before sign-off.
- DraftSure: Drafts only from approved facts; export stays locked until findings are resolved, with a complete audit record.

A person decides. Your reviewer approves or rejects each finding and makes the final decision.

## Who it is for

Insurers, public bodies, fuel retailers and industrial groups, and teams handling procurement, grants and compliance evidence, who must check documents before they pay, accept or sign.

## Deployment

Runs in your own AWS account or on-premises. You choose where the models run, including your own GPU servers. Access is set per project, and actions and decisions are recorded in an activity log.
